title: make_symmetric
description: Registers an input image to its left/right reversed version using mri_robust_register in a half-way space and mirrors the selected hemisphere.

hemi.description: The hemisphere to mirror; accepted values are 'lh' for left hemisphere or 'rh' for right hemisphere.
hemi.title: Hemisphere

output_file.description: Output image in .mgz format resulting from the symmetric processing.
output_file.title: Output file

transform_map.description: Transformation map in .lta format mapping the input to the upright space.
transform_map.title: Transform map file
